title: PhD alumni
text:
Earlier doctoral programmes
Before 2018 doctoral training in statistics at Milano-Bicocca ran through other programmes: Statistics, Statistics and Applications, and Statistics and Mathematical Finance (statistics curriculum only). The list covers the theses deposited in the BOA institutional repository from 2010 onwards. Supervision is taken from the title page of each thesis; where the title page names only a tutor, the tutor is listed as supervisor. Current positions in Italian universities come from the MUR register of academic staff; the others are still to be completed.

Download the data (CSV)


Last updated October 2026. Corrections and missing positions are welcome: the data live in phd/data/alumni.csv.

title: Statistics seminars
text:
Researchers from other universities present their work at Milano-Bicocca. Seminars are in English, last about an hour and are open to the whole Bicocca community, students included. The room changes from one seminar to the next: check it here before you go. Seminars in economics and management are listed in the DEMS events calendar.

Download the list of seminars (CSV)


Data in phd/data/seminars.csv. Seminars before 2022 are not listed yet.
